name: Bayanno: Multi-Purpose Handwritten Dataset for Bengali Language Processing
description: Bayanno is a multi-purpose handwritten Bengali image dataset designed for optical character recognition, character classification, and handwriting analysis across Bengali characters, numbers, and continuous text.
